'''Gibad''' was one of the few [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that defied [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] shortly after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Home to parks and beautiful [[City/Legends|cities]], the [[Gibadan Academy of Life Sciences]] was a well respected university in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

When the planet refused to cooperate after the Empire's given deadline, Palpatine [[Devastation of Gibad|unleashed]] a [[FG36|virus]] on the world created by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]], who was a native of the planet. As all [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] watched the destruction of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] population of the planet, the Empire released a statement saying that the world would be ready for re-population within the year.<ref name="IC 501st" />
